verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents core accounting infrastructure that would support these statements — double-entry chart of accounts, journal entries, accountant collaboration to 'run reports', and a Reports API exposing 'seven types of reports' (though only Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry, and Payments Collected are named) plus generic 'tax-time reports' and 'detailed financial reports' claims. However, no evidence explicitly confirms dedicated Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, or Cash Flow statement reports or on-demand period selection for them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming P&L/balance sheet/cash-flow reports, evidence of on-demand period customization, and independent/hands-on confirmation of report accuracy.
